item.title: Dubai Desert Classic Day 4: Can Reed hold out his lead on final day?
item.description: Patrick Reed has taken a commanding four-point lead at the Dubai Desert Classic after an impressive 67 on Moving Day. With a total of 14 under par, Reed is poised to claim his first Desert Classic title. His closest competitor, David Puig, trails at 10 under, while Viktor Hovland and Andy Sullivan are tied for third at nine under. Despite strong performances, Rory McIlroy and Tommy Fleetwood are unlikely to challenge for the title, sitting well behind the leaders.
